tasks.FindHorizontalAsymptote: Calculate the horizontal asymptote of the function f(x) = 2x / (x^2 - 5x - 14).
tasks.FindVerticalAsymptotes: Determine the vertical asymptotes of the function f(x) = 2x / (x^2 - 5x - 14).
tasks.SumAsymptotes: Compute the sum a + b + c where a and b are vertical asymptotes, and c is the horizontal asymptote.
